content.title: Lake Arbor Golf Course
content.summary: Lake Arbor Golf Club, located in east Arvada, Colorado, offers a player-friendly 5,900-yard course known for its excellent greens and walkable layout, making it ideal for both casual and experienced golfers. The club provides great value and encourages golfers to improve their accuracy and short game. For more details and to book tee times, visit the Lake Arbor Golf website.
content.body:
## Club Overview

Lake Arbor Golf Club in east Arvada, Colorado, is a lush oasis in an urban setting. Outstanding value and some of the best greens in the Denver area are what keep golfers coming back again and again.

This player-friendly course measures about 5,900 yards in length and has a very walkable layout for those who enjoy a classic round. If you are an experienced golfer, you will find this is the place to tune up your accuracy and your short game.

## Lake Arbor Website

For more information and to book a tee time [visit the Lake Arbor Golf website](https://www.lakearborgolf.com/).
